products.product_description: BLUEBERRY PRETZEL, NET WEIGHT : 4OZ (113g) ,USE BY DATE : 12/1/2018
products.reason_for_recall: Four Link Nutriworld has initiated a recall of NATURAL WHOLE NUT - BLUEBERRY PRETZEL, 4.0z, used by date of 12/01/2018 because of mislabeled product. The "MILK" ingredient was omitted in the ingredient section. Blueberry Pretzel has a coating that includes milk content. This can cause milk allergen to people who are allergic to milk.
